description: Audit ANY URL for AI-search readiness only (AEO/GEO/LLMO) — how likely ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity & Google AI are to cite it. Checks ~7 AI-citation signals (FAQ/structured-data/entity schema, citable stats, llms.txt, author/E-E-A-T, OG). Returns a weighted 0–100 AI-readiness score + top fixes. Takes a `url`. Use full_seo_audit for the broader SEO picture, or get_my_store_audit for the user's own connected store. Returns a summary of the top issues; the complete written report is available via email_seo_report.

url.description: The website URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

name: ai_search_diagnostic
